# VS Code Light

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-vscode-light)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-vscode-light)
[![npm downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dt/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-vscode-light)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-vscode-light)

VS Code Light is a **light** CodeMirror 6 theme whose text colors all meet WCAG AA contrast. It belongs to the VS Code family.

[Open in playground](../../playground/theme-gallery/) to compare it with the other themes.

## Install

```bash
npm install @fsegurai/codemirror-theme-vscode-light codemirror
```

The theme is also exported as `vsCodeLight` by `@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-bundle`.

## Usage

```ts
import { basicSetup, EditorView } from 'codemirror';
import { vsCodeLight } from '@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-vscode-light';

new EditorView({
  doc: 'const answer = 42;',
  extensions: [basicSetup, vsCodeLight],
  parent: document.body,
});
```

| Export | Type |
|---|---|
| `vsCodeLight` | `Extension` |
| `vsCodeLightMergeStyles` | `IMergeRevertStyles` |
| `applyMergeRevertStyles` | `(styles: IMergeRevertStyles) => void` |

## Editor surfaces

Translucent colors are composited over the background, which is the color text is measured against.

| Surface | Color |
|---|---|
| Background | `#ffffff` |
| Active line | `#f0f0f0` |
| Selection | `#bddeff` |

## Syntax colors

Resolved highlight styles for common [Lezer tags](https://lezer.codemirror.net/docs/ref/#highlight.tags) and their contrast ratio. WCAG AA requires 4.5:1 for text; the lowest ratio of this theme, over all tags, is 4.52:1 on the selection.

| Role | Tag | Color | Style | On background | On active line | On selection |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Keyword | `keyword` | `#0756d7` | bold | 6.32:1 | 5.55:1 | 4.53:1 |
| Control keyword | `controlKeyword` | `#9f02c8` | bold | 6.33:1 | 5.56:1 | 4.54:1 |
| Operator | `operator` | `#383a42` | - | 11.34:1 | 9.95:1 | 8.13:1 |
| Punctuation | `punctuation` | `#383a42` | - | 11.34:1 | 9.95:1 | 8.13:1 |
| Variable | `variableName` | `#0f62a7` | - | 6.32:1 | 5.54:1 | 4.53:1 |
| Variable definition | `definition(variableName)` | `#0f62a7` | - | 6.32:1 | 5.54:1 | 4.53:1 |
| Function call | `function(variableName)` | `#765b23` | - | 6.38:1 | 5.60:1 | 4.57:1 |
| Property | `propertyName` | `#0f62a7` | - | 6.32:1 | 5.54:1 | 4.53:1 |
| Type | `typeName` | `#116880` | - | 6.33:1 | 5.56:1 | 4.54:1 |
| Class | `className` | `#116880` | - | 6.33:1 | 5.56:1 | 4.54:1 |
| Namespace | `namespace` | `#383a42` | - | 11.34:1 | 9.95:1 | 8.13:1 |
| String | `string` | `#a31515` | - | 7.85:1 | 6.89:1 | 5.63:1 |
| Regular expression | `regexp` | `#9f02c8` | - | 6.33:1 | 5.56:1 | 4.54:1 |

## Editor UI colors

Non-text indicators need 3:1 (WCAG 1.4.11). The selection must stay distinguishable on the active line (1.15:1 or more).

| Element | Selector | Color | Measured against | Ratio | Result |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Text | `&` | `#383a42` | background, active line, selection | 8.13:1 | Pass |
| Line numbers | `.cm-gutters` | `#237893` | gutter | 4.61:1 | Pass |
| Cursor | `.cm-cursor` | `#000000` | background, active line | 18.43:1 | Pass |
| Focus ring | `&.cm-focused` | `#5f5f5f` | background | 6.39:1 | Pass |
| Matching bracket outline | `.cm-matchingBracket` | `1px solid #007accd0` | background, active line | 3.05:1 | Pass |
| Current search match | `.cm-searchMatch-selected` | `#90caf9, 1px solid #0f62a7a8` | background (fill or outline) | 3.09:1 | Pass |
| Selection | `.cm-selectionBackground` | `#bddeff` | active line | 1.22:1 | Pass |
